sections.Profile:
The "Jubilee" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in May 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, four rollover buttons, and a standup target.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Wood Rail, Original Theme
